Whether the ERCOT batch-zero large-load pipeline converts into energized, rate-based load on the stated timeline — "14 gigawatts of these submissions are expected to be eligible for batch zero. And would represent an increase of more than 65% from Houston Electric's current system peak of 21 gigawatts.". The $66.7B plan, the 7-9%-through-2035 algorithm and the $5B customer-affordability claim are all built on that conversion, and the transmission capex it implies is NOT yet in the plan — "we intend to provide a more comprehensive transmission study update the seco
